description:
First port slice: a working `OctoPi.AI.stream/3` against real Anthropic Messages API, emitting the canonical event stream.

Scope:
- HTTP client choice (Req vs Finch; cancellation semantics).
- `OctoPi.AI.Provider` behaviour + canonical event types (matching pi-ai's AssistantMessageEvent).
- Streaming JSON parser (port of pi-ai's `parseStreamingJson` / `partial-json` lib for tool-call argument deltas).
- Incremental SSE decoder handling `\r\n` and `\n` line terminators.
- Anthropic provider: message/tool codec + `stream/3` implementation.
- `OctoPi.AI.stream/3` public entry returning an Elixir `Stream` backed by a producer process.
- Mix task: `mix ai.demo "prompt"` — reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, streams deltas to stdout.

Definition of done: demo task produces streaming text from claude-3-5-sonnet. Tool-call events parse correctly with a fake tool. No other providers yet.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.1, §4.1, §4.2, §6 Phase 1.
title: Phase 1: octo_pi_ai — Anthropic MVP
